name: LMS Topic 11 - Autonomous Support & Lead Generation Agent

parameters.query:
-- TEMPORARY / ADMIN SETUP NODE for LMS Topic 11. Not connected to the live webhook flow.
-- 1) Create required tables (idempotent)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
    customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (
    ticket_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id TEXT,
    subject TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
    customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    plan TEXT,
    mrr NUMERIC,
    account_status TEXT,
    is_lead BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    amount NUMERIC,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS token_usage_log (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ticket_id TEXT,
    customer_id TEXT,
    execution_id TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    input_tokens INTEGER,
    output_tokens INTEGER,
    total_tokens INTEGER,
    status TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 2) Seed idempotent demo/test data (safe to re-run)
INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, name, email, status)
VALUES ('CUST-1001', 'Jane Doe', 'jane@example.com', 'active')
ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO accounts (customer_id, plan, mrr, account_status, is_lead)
VALUES ('CUST-1001', 'Enterprise', 999, 'active', TRUE)
ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO orders (order_id, customer_id, status, amount)
VALUES ('ORD-1001', 'CUST-1001', 'completed', 999)
ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING;

-- Primary test ticket + previous ticket history (for the LIMIT 5 history query)
INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_id, customer_id, subject, status, created_at) VALUES
    ('TCK-9001', 'CUST-1001', 'Interested in upgrading to Enterprise plan', 'open', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
    ('TCK-9000', 'CUST-1001', 'Question about invoice for last month', 'closed', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 days'),
    ('TCK-8999', 'CUST-1001', 'How do I add more seats to my plan?', 'closed', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '12 days'),
    ('TCK-8998', 'CUST-1001', 'Password reset not working', 'closed', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '20 days'),
    ('TCK-8997', 'CUST-1001', 'Requesting a product demo', 'closed', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days'),
    ('TCK-8996', 'CUST-1001', 'General onboarding questions', 'closed', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '45 days')
ON CONFLICT (ticket_id) DO NOTHING;
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE customer_id = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT ticket_id, subject, status, created_at FROM tickets WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT plan, mrr, account_status, is_lead FROM accounts WHERE customer_id = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;

options.systemMessage:
You are an autonomous customer support and lead-generation agent.
Analyze the current ticket together with the retrieved customer context and respond with ONE JSON object matching the required schema. No prose outside the JSON.

Decision rules:
- category: high-level bucket (SUPPORT, BILLING, ACCOUNT, TECHNICAL, SALES, GENERAL).
- priority: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or URGENT.
- intent: short snake_case label (e.g. payment_issue, upgrade_request, bug_report).
- Detect sales/upgrade/purchase interest -> set "lead": true and recommended_action "lead_followup".
- Set "auto_resolve": true ONLY when the answer is fully supported by the provided context and is low-risk. Then recommended_action "auto_resolve".
- For high-risk, ambiguous, billing/payment, security, or uncertain requests -> set "escalate": true and recommended_action "human_escalation". Never set auto_resolve in that case.
- customer_response: concise, professional message to the customer. When escalating, acknowledge and set expectations — NEVER claim the issue is fixed or resolved.
- internal_summary: 1-2 sentences for the internal team.

Strict grounding — you MUST NOT invent or assume any of the following if it is not present in the retrieved context: customer data, order data, payment status, account information, product information, or company policy. If information is missing, escalate instead of guessing.
Never include secrets, credentials, internal system details, or raw context dumps in customer_response.
